title: Sources Sought: Smart T Power Project
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > FA2517  21 CONS BLDG 350
description:
The Peterson Space Force Base (PSFB) 21st Contracting Squadron is requesting information from vendors who provide the work outlined in Attachement 1 – PWS Smart T Power Project. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 238210 – Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors, and the small business size standard is $19 Million Dollars 

 This sources sought is issued for the purpose of market research in accordance with RFO Part 10. PSFB, CO is requesting information for the subject part number for Market Research Purposes.
